Steamed now runs on **Minecraft 26.1**, so every 26.x release is covered.

### New

- **Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1 and 26.1.2** on Fabric and Quilt, and **26.1.2** on NeoForge (NeoForge only has stable
  builds for 26.1.2). Everything that works on 26.2 and 26.3 works the same here
- **Fewer pointless updates.** From now on, a jar only gets a new version when something in it changed. If a release
  only touches 26.3, the 26.2 jars stay on their current version and you won't be asked to update them

| Jar | Minecraft | Also needs |
|---|---|---|
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.3+26.3.jar` | 26.3 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.3+26.3.jar` | 26.3 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.3+26.3.jar` | 26.3 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.3+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.3+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.3+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.3+26.1.jar` | 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.3+26.1.jar` | 26.1.2 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.3+26.1.jar` | 26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.3+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21, 1.21.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.3+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21.1 | Kotlin for Forge 5.12+ |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.3+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-forge-0.2.3+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20.1 | Kotlin for Forge 4.12+ |

### Good to know

- Joining is now checked by Steamed's network protocol instead of the exact version number, so players on different
  Steamed versions can play together as long as the protocol matches. 0.2.2 and older still need an exact match, so
  update to 0.2.3 together with your friends this one time
- Joining across two Steam accounts hasn't been tested on 26.1 yet
